import sys
import heapq


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n, m = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    t = list(map(int, data[2:2 + n]))
    heap = [(x, x) for x in t]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    last = 0
    for _ in range(m):
        finish, x = heapq.heappop(heap)
        last = finish
        heapq.heappush(heap, (finish + x, x))
    print(last)


main()
